commit.message:
fix(browser): throttle unsent-wake retry storms, atomic clear-and-type, composer-uncleanable rollover

Live follow-up to #827 (2026-09-19, build 35424833345.1, session paprika1):

D-K5 — unsent-wake retry storm. A wake that was prepared but provably
not sent (pre-effect throw: replace unverified, stale ref, composer
unresolvable) was re-prepared on the very next monitor tick, and the
CONTINUE_DEVELOPMENT reason bypasses the wake interval entirely — a
permanent pre-effect failure became a ~2s retry storm that raced the
page's draft-sync and appended ~3k chars of wake text per minute to
the composer (live: the supervisor composer grew 12k -> 33k in minutes;
the site itself reset it, then re-restored a 12k draft and the loop
kept appending). resolveAmbiguous({observed_sent:false}) now records
last_unsent_attempt_at; canWake charges the wake interval for every
unsent attempt regardless of reason; confirmWakeSent clears it.

D-K6 — atomic clear-and-type. Live probes proved the D-K2 escalation
retry NEVER ran (the first insert's own DOM mutation invalidated the
semantic ref, attempt 2 threw native_semantic_ref_stale BEFORE the
Delete) while each attempt left an appended copy — a post-effect
exception with an unreported physical mutation. The verified replace
is now ONE atomic gesture: Ctrl+A, Delete (honors the selection;
no-op when the site prevents selection), insertText, then AX-value
readback verification. Deliberately NO second attempt: re-typing after
a mutated attempt would append a second copy of the prompt.

D-K7 — bounded rollover on a provably unusable composer. Three
consecutive composer-blocking send failures (TYPE_EFFECT_AMBIGUOUS,
replace_unverified, ref stale, composer not unique) now request a
rollover to a FRESH conversation — a new surface has an empty composer
where a verified replace is trivial — instead of retrying into the
same site-re-restored poisoned draft forever.

Test-harness truth fixed along the way: the continuity fake lacked
markGenerationStarted, so every 'successful' send threw post-effect
and the old always-retry canWake silently masked it; the over-specific
message assertion now accepts both documented wake variants.

Tests: glm-composer-resolution-verified-type-repair.test.mjs grows to
16 contract tests (atomic-gesture verified/append/unprovable paths,
single-insertText invariant, D-K5 throttle unit, D-K7 rollover e2e).
Full suite: 2402 pass / 0 fail / 2 skip. npm run check clean.
